name: ai-citation-check
title: AI Citation Check
description: Flags tells of made-up references (DOI prefix not matching the journal, a dash in a DOI, impossible years, leftover oaicite or 【4†source】 markers, unattributed quotes), looks DOIs, cases and links up via a pluggable verify, and marks anything unconfirmed Unverified.

meta.stops: Unverified references slip into AI text
meta.summary: Flags references in AI-written text that look made up and looks each one up, so fake cases and DOIs are caught before they go out.
catches: DOI prefixes that do not belong to the publisher of the journal named
Long dashes inside a DOI and leftover AI citation markers, with one-tap fixes
Case reporter/year combinations that cannot exist, and years in the future
References your verify function could not confirm, shown as Unverified rather than fine
limits: Without a verify function it only checks the text for tells; it cannot confirm anything exists
A reference that exists may still be misquoted or not support the claim
Publisher-prefix and reporter heuristics cover common cases, not every journal or court
Submitting is still possible after a second press
a11y: Textarea gets aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing at the summary
Lookup progress is announced in a role="status" region; the submit confirmation uses role="alert"
"Show" moves focus to the reference in the list
Statuses use text and icons, not colour alone; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion
